name: Mateo Alvarez
bio:
Mateo's passion for motorsport ignited in his childhood, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering at the University of Buenos Aires, focusing on vehicle dynamics and aerodynamics. After graduating, Mateo gained practical experience working with a local touring car team before making the leap to international competition. He joined Walkenhorst Motorsport two years ago, quickly establishing himself as a reliable and adaptable engineer. 

Mateo excels at translating driver feedback into tangible improvements in car setup. He believes in a collaborative approach, fostering open communication between the driver, mechanics, and other engineers. Mateo's analytical skills and attention to detail enable him to identify subtle performance gains, while his big-picture thinking helps him strategize effectively during races. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to adapt to changing track conditions.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave.
physical.description: Mateo is of medium build with a focused gaze.
